user.title: GyverLamp2
user.description: HA owns the settings of 10 modes. The first mode command replaces the lamp mode bank. No app presets or custom-palette editor. Built-in palette selection is supported. Disable heartbeat requirement for one-way control if broadcasts are unavailable. Slave is optional: it can set global brightness to 255; otherwise per-mode brightness is limited by the existing global lamp brightness.

error.cannot_listen: Could not open the UDP port; it may be in use.
error.no_heartbeat: No heartbeat received. Check address, group, key and LAN broadcasts. Unconfirmed presence mode is available if needed.
